title: Saratoga Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Saratoga is a 3 BR / 3 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Welcome to Saratoga, our lovely and spacious cottage located steps away from the family pool in the heart of award-winning Seaside, Florida.
description_expanded: Description725 FOREST STREET2 KINGS, 2 QUEENS - Sleeps 8 Welcome to Saratoga Cottage in Seaside, FloridaSaratoga Cottage is a spacious, light-filled vacation rental located in the heart of Seaside, Florida, just steps from the family pool and a short walk to the beach and town center. Designed with vaulted ceilings, expansive windows, and an open-concept layout, this three-bedroom, three-bathroom home comfortably accommodates up to eight guests. Whether you are planning a family beach week or a 30A getaway with friends, Saratoga offers generous living space and an unbeatable walkable location along Scenic Highway 30A.Elevated Outdoor Living in the Heart of 30AOutdoor living defines the Saratoga experience. Two expansive Southern-facing porches span the length of the home, creating multiple spaces to relax, gather, and enjoy Seaside’s coastal breezes. The upper-level porch now features a new oversized daybed swing, offering the perfect spot for afternoon naps, reading, or evening cocktails. A foosball table and additional swing seating create a casual and inviting atmosphere for guests of all ages.On the ground level, a newly added Adirondack seating area for four provides another comfortable outdoor gathering space beneath the coastal sky. Enjoy morning coffee, sunset conversations, or quiet downtime after the beach. After a short walk or bike ride home from Seaside’s white-sand beaches, rinse off in the fully enclosed outdoor shower with hot and cold running water — ideal for keeping sand outside where it belongs. With multiple porch levels and shaded seating areas, Saratoga maximizes indoor-outdoor living in true Seaside style.Thoughtfully Designed Bedrooms with Private Porch AccessSaratoga’s three-bedroom layout balances shared gathering space with privacy and comfort. The primary King bedroom is located on the ground floor and features a large closet, desk area, and direct access to the porch. A washer and dryer on the main level add convenience for extended stays.Upstairs, two guest bedrooms offer vaulted ceilings and private bathrooms. One oversized bedroom features two Queen beds and a recently renovated en suite bath, opening directly onto the expansive upper porch. The second upstairs King bedroom includes a private, updated bathroom and overlooks the main living area below. Every bedroom includes a television and French doors that open directly onto the home’s porches, creating a seamless connection between indoor comfort and outdoor relaxation.Open-Concept Living with Soaring CeilingsAt the center of the home is a bright and airy open-concept living area anchored by dramatic 20-foot windows and abundant natural light. Built-in shelving and a coastal color palette create a welcoming, relaxed atmosphere. The spacious layout allows your entire group to gather comfortably for meals, games, or movie nights.The fully equipped kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, expansive quartz countertops, and everything needed to prepare meals at home. Whether cooking fresh Gulf seafood or bringing home takeout from Seaside’s celebrated restaurants, the kitchen and adjacent dining area provide plenty of space to dine and connect. The living area also includes a full entertainment system with WiFi-enabled speakers for effortless evenings in.Walkable Location in Award-Winning Seaside, FloridaSaratoga Cottage places you in the heart of Seaside, one of the most iconic beach towns along Florida’s Emerald Coast. From nearly half a mile of private beach access and sugar-white sand to boutique shopping, local art galleries, live music, and outdoor movies in the amphitheater, Seaside offers a true 30A lifestyle experience.With the family pool just steps away and the beach and town center within easy walking distance, Saratoga delivers the ideal combination of space, location, and elevated outdoor living. This Seaside, Florida vacation rental is the perfect home base for creating lasting memories along the Gulf Coast.Come stay at Saratoga and discover why guests return to Seaside, Florida year after year. * 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,800 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space5-minute walk (352 yards) to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30ASteps from the main family pool and a short walk to Seaside shops, dining, and the Seaside ChapelPrimary bedroom located on the ground floorNewly updated mattresses throughout the homeYouTubeTV available for guest entertainmentOutdoor foosball table for family fun on porchKeurig coffee makerPeacock Alley linens — fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeEnclosed outdoor shower and charcoal grill Washer and dryerHigh-speed WiFi with upgraded routerAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleb all courts (ct. fees apply) , and a fitness center Personalized service throughout your stay, including a welcome tote upon arrival and two rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityTwo parking passes are issued (a golf cart is considered a vehicle). Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002232
